card.name: Didanosine interaction warning text
card.fires_on: Words inside the tenofovir/didanosine interaction warning, such as 'for', 'develop' and 'including' right before 'didanosine-associated adverse reactions'. Also fires on a few section numbers and headings in warnings lists.

modes.label: Didanosine warning wording
modes.description: Linking words just before 'didanosine-associated adverse reactions' or in the list after it.
modes.example: Patients receiving VIREAD and didanosine should be monitored closely<< for>> didanosine-associated adverse reactions.

modes.label: Warning section headings
modes.description: Numbers or word starts inside warning headings and bullet lists.

card.plain: It lights up on the small words in the warning that didanosine taken with tenofovir needs close monitoring, and a few warning headings.
evidence: Patients receiving VIREAD and didanosine should be monitored closely<< for>> didanosine-associated adverse reactions.
